sha_method: sha256 of the LF-normalised UTF-8 prompt file; schema_sha = sha256 of canonical JSON
truncation_policy: one retry at 2x max_tokens; any other non-end_turn stop is an error
input: variant-a query text only ("Question: <text>"); never narratives, rephrases or clause text
use: variant c: stage 2 ranks with the HyDE embedding; stage 1 = the variant-a Cypher of the same arm and gen
